name: materials-ml-applicability-domain-assessment
description: 材料科学机器学习中适用域（Applicability Domain, AD）的评估方法，包括基于距离的方法（kNN、LOF）、概率密度估计、OCSVM单类边界学习、以及基于领域知识的约束；AUCR超参数优化准则；小样本条件下AD评估的特殊考虑；适用域外（OOD）预测结果的可靠性量化与candidate_report集成标记方法
harvest_query: 材料科学机器学习中适用域评估方法，Mahalanobis距离、KNN、概率密度估计

evidence_papers.title: Identifying domains of applicability of machine learning models for materials science
A general approach for determining applicability domain of machine learning models
Evaluation and Optimization Methods for Applicability Domain Methods and Their Hyperparameters, Considering the Prediction Performance of Machine Learning Models
